_doc: Per-model settings for tests/run_shipped_models.py (see tests/README.md). tier: fast (every PR), slow (manual / push to main), local (never in CI; needs a tier_reason), skip (never run; needs a reason). heavy: run alone, never in parallel. Overrides: weather (passed as -w), max_unmet_heating_hours, max_unmet_cooling_hours, zone_temp_limits_c ({zone: [lo, hi]}); each override needs a matching <key>_reason.
